name: China Qinfa Group Limited
summary: China Qinfa Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the mining, purchase and sale, filtering, storage, and blending of coal in the People's Republic of China and Indonesia. It engages in goods transport and logistics, and charter hire activities; rental office activity; sale of machine and machine materials; and machine repairing, as well as shipping transportation business. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. China Qinfa Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Fortune Pearl International Limited.
